inputSpecification: The model requires orthos png format. Input images must be 1024x1024 pixels. Orthos must be provided as a 3-channel image with 8 - 10 cm resolution.
outputSpecification: The model outputs a 1024*1024 binary mask
trainingDataOrigin: The model has been trained on orthos from different parts of The Netherlands.
moreInformation: Geo Expertise Centre of Kadaster Nederland
